prompts.name: sap_odata_basics
prompts.content: Query pattern: sap_discover (find entity) -> sap_entity_metadata (keys/properties) -> sap_read with $filter (e.g. "BusinessPartnerID eq '1000001'"), $select, $orderby, $top. Single read via sap_read_one with keys object. Writes always gated: preview -> validate -> execute with confirm=true.

prompts.name: safe_write_review
prompts.description: Review a proposed SAP write before executing
prompts.content: Flow: 1) sap_preview_write 2) sap_validate_write (fix unknown_property / keys_required / not_creatable issues) 3) sap_execute_approved_write with confirm=true. Requires SAP_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=1. Tokens single-use, TTL 600s, instance-bound. Updates send If-Match * unless an ETag is passed.
